title: Deadlocks messages on actual nightly
body:
As written on gitter: Since some nightlys I see deadlocks ...

![Screenshot_20210203-182346](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12517693/106784858-140f6400-664d-11eb-8d76-efb88aaa23a7.png)

xDrip+ Nightly
Version e89e23d-2021.01.29

Dexcom G6, 80....., Firmware 1.6.5.25

comments.body:
Me too. What does it mean?
Thank you

Edit: in my case Libre2+OOP2
Would you please include in the first post what CGM and transmitter this is about so that it becomes a self-contained issue?

These are mine G6, 80, 20210111

I seem to see them more forced collecting from Wear (patched Huawei 1).

![Screenshot_20210207-074651_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25760491/107127100-ba42be80-6918-11eb-9020-43ae872d62ab.jpg)
I don't wear a WearOS watch.
Sorry for the red herring, I turned off Wear collection and still see the deadlocks. Some periods seem worse than others. Maybe walking in and out of range. Will have to test that theory though.
Please try [Nightly build 8th Feb 2021](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.02.08) which should have addressed this problem.
Haven't seen anymore errors since upgrading several hours ago.
Thanks a lot for the fix: The deadlock errors are gone!
